profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems | AWS | Enterprise Microservices  | Java / Python | AI Developer
profile.summary:
Backend engineer with 5+ years of experience owning enterprise Java/Spring
microservices and internal developer platforms in large production environments.

My work focuses on modernizing legacy systems, improving reliability,
and building automation that reduces operational overhead. I currently
own multiple high-throughput backend services processing thousands of
requests per minute and supporting cross-team infrastructure.

I have led runtime upgrades, dependency migrations, security remediation,
and cloud readiness initiatives while also developing internal automation
frameworks that replace manual testing workflows and improve deployment confidence.

Interested in senior backend roles involving distributed systems,
cloud infrastructure, or modernization-focused platform work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical owner for multiple enterprise backend systems supporting internal financial infrastructure, cross-team integrations, and the AI tooling layer built on top of them.

Own ISVOmni, a high-throughput IBM MQ routing service processing hundreds to thousands of internal requests per minute and routing traffic across critical backend systems.

Own ISVSupport, an internal observability and debugging platform used by multiple engineering teams for request visualization, log filtering, API testing, and service monitoring.

Built and maintain a documented AI knowledge base using AWS Kiro across 20+ repositories, giving developers implementation context for pre-sprint ticket analysis and reducing ramp-up time on unfamiliar code.

Rebuilt the WellnessCheck internal developer platform, redesigning frontend and backend request handling to implement caching strategies and improve stability, resulting in 3–5× performance improvements.

Developed an automated Selenium validation framework that runs daily system checks and distributes results to teams, eliminating manual QA workflows and improving production confidence.

Led modernization initiatives including runtime upgrades, dependency migrations, security remediation, and cloud-readiness implementation.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · Python (Programming Language) · Systems Design · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Software Architecture · Prompt Engineering · Legacy Modernization · Microservices · Java · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) · Distributed Systems · Production Support · System Monitoring · Agile Software Development · Angular

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed backend REST services using Scala and Spring for
enterprise-scale distributed data processing systems.

Worked with AWS Lambda, Spark EMR, and Elasticsearch pipelines
to support near-real-time analytics workflows.

Deployed microservices to Kubernetes and AWS environments while
maintaining CI/CD pipelines and improving service reliability.
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · Systems Design · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Software Architecture · Apache Spark · Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Elasticsearch · Production Support · System Monitoring · Agile Software Development · REST APIs

positions.title: Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered containerized enterprise software deployments using Docker
and AWS, configuring environments tailored to individual client
infrastructure requirements.

Owned implementation projects end-to-end including requirements
analysis, environment setup, system customization, and production
deployment support.

Extended and configured existing Hyland platform components to meet
client-specific needs while improving deployment efficiency through
AWS-based container testing environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Systems Design · Docker · Legacy Modernization · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · System Monitoring

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Backend developer for GM’s direct-to-consumer payment and billing
platform supporting enterprise transaction processing.

Built Spring-based REST microservices and collaborated across
frontend/backend teams to ensure reliable API communication.

Implemented automated testing strategies achieving high module
coverage and supported multi-environment deployment validation.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Microservices · Java · System Monitoring · PostgreSQL · Agile Software Development · REST APIs

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on secure server architecture validation for U.S. Navy systems
within a compliance-driven environment.

Used Linux virtualization and testing frameworks to validate system
security and operational readiness.

positions.title: Office Manager
positions.description:
Early Career Role (Pre-Software Engineering)

Managed office operations and workflow processes for a landscaping
business while coordinating scheduling, materials, and project logistics.

Identified operational inefficiencies and led migration to a web-based
service platform, improving workflow efficiency by over 200%.

Supported leadership in implementing operational strategies that
contributed to significant business revenue growth.

positions.title: Machine Technician
positions.description:
Early Career Role (Pre-Software Engineering)

Maintained and troubleshot 120+ networked arcade machines and systems,
diagnosing hardware and connectivity issues to ensure operational uptime.

Managed parts inventory and coordinated repairs with manufacturers
to maintain reliable system performance.
